column1: # cover-view-urls.tsv — for DS libraries with NO on-disk cover: show a clickable "[view artwork]"
# link (opens the image/page in a browser) instead of embedding (rights-safe fallback).
# Format (TAB-separated):  <exact entry name><TAB><https URL to the cover image or its Pianobook page>
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Used ONLY when the library has no on-disk cover and no covers-manual override.
# Most of the 43 blank libraries are free Pianobook packs; their page is https://www.pianobook.co.uk/packs/<slug>/
